home.headline: Spend a semester somewhere new.
home.description: Find a partner at another university. Science Swap connects people in similar fields whose dates and preferred destinations work for both.

profile.title: Create a profile
profile.description: Enter your university and field of study. Your university tells us your city, country, and region.

preferences.title: Choose dates and destinations
preferences.description: Choose when you’re available for an exchange and add the countries or regions you’d like to visit.

matches.title: Find an exchange partner
matches.description: See whose dates and destinations fit yours. When you’re both interested, you can get in touch.

login.title: Sign in or register
login.description: Enter an email address to try the flow.
login.demo: Demo mode. The demo profile is available in this tab. Email sign-in links will come later.

error.storage: Your browser is blocking session storage. Allow it to start the demo.

demoProfile.title: Your demo profile
demoProfile.description: The demo has started. The profile form will be added in a later step.
